form.congress: One Hundred Eighteenth Congress of the United States of America
form.enrolled-dateline: Begun and held at the City of Washington on Wednesday, the third day of January, two thousand and twenty-four
form.official-title: To amend title II of the Social Security Act to repeal the Government pension offset and windfall elimination provisions.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Social Security Fairness Act of 2023.

section.header: Repeal of government pension offset provision

subsection.text: Section 202(k) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 402(k)) is amended by striking paragraph (5).

paragraph.text: Section 202(b)(2) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 402(b)(2)) is amended by striking subsections (k)(5) and (q) and inserting subsection (q).
Section 202(c)(2) of such Act (42 U.S.C. 402(c)(2)) is amended by striking subsections (k)(5) and (q) and inserting subsection (q).
Section 202(e)(2)(A) of such Act (42 U.S.C. 402(e)(2)(A)) is amended by striking subsection (k)(5), subsection (q), and inserting subsection (q).
Section 202(f)(2)(A) of such Act (42 U.S.C. 402(f)(2)(A)) is amended by striking subsection (k)(5), subsection (q) and inserting subsection (q).

subsection.text: Section 215 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 415) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subsection (d), by striking paragraph (3); and

subsection.text: Subsections (e)(2) and (f)(2) of section 202 of such Act (42 U.S.C. 402) are each amended by striking section 215(f)(5), 215(f)(6), or 215(f)(9)(B) in subparagraphs (C) and (D)(i) and inserting paragraph (5) or (6) of section 215(f).

section.text: The amendments made by this Act shall apply with respect to monthly insurance benefits payable under title II of the Social Security Act for months after December 2023. Notwithstanding section 215(f) of the Social Security Act, the Commissioner of Social Security shall adjust primary insurance amounts to the extent necessary to take into account the amendments made by section 3.
